note: The test-colocation gate's exceptions (tools/src/gates/check-test-colocation.ts reads it; nothing generates from it). Every module under tools/src/ has a sibling *.test.ts or an importing suite in its folder, and every hook under .claude/hooks/ has a test that names it — or an entry here. An entry is { name, match, reason }: match is an exact path or a whole-path glob, reason says why the thing needs no test. An entry that excuses a failure rather than a category also carries owner and since. The list ships empty, and the gate fails an entry that excuses nothing, so an exception cannot outlive its cause. Edit this file, then run: make gate G=check-test-colocation.
